paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on Llama3.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates model accuracy (ACC) as a function of co-occurrence number for six methods on Llama3, shown as multiple colored line series. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels at 0, 10¹, 10², and 10³; the plotted points appear at four increasing co-occurrence values spanning from the leftmost point (just above 0, around a few units) to the rightmost point (a few thousand). The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 60 to 85 with evenly spaced tick marks every 5 percentage points. The Base series is a black solid line with circular markers, rising from about 61% at the leftmost point to about 67% at the rightmost point (with intermediate points near 63% and 65%). FT is a blue solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers, increasing from roughly 62% to roughly 68% across the x-axis (with middle values around 65% and 68%). IKE is a red solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, moving upward from about 64.5% at the first point to about 70% at the last point (with intermediate values near 68% and 69%). MEND is a brown solid line with diamond markers, increasing from about 66% initially to about 74% at the final point, passing through values around 71% and 73% at the middle x positions. MEMIT is a purple solid line with hexagon-like markers, rising from about 66.5% at the first point to about 72.5% at the last point (with intermediate values around 70% and 71%). ROME is a green solid line with square markers, increasing from about 72% at the leftmost point to about 77.5% at the rightmost point, with middle points around 76% and 77.5%.
